sidewalk_through.description: Traverse one connected sidewalk corridor inside a sidewalk cell.

junction_through.description: Move straight through a junction cell while staying on sidewalk edges only.

crosswalk_cross.description: Cross a road through at least one marked crosswalk edge.

unmarked_junction_cross.description: Cross a junction through unmarked jaywalking-at-junction edges without a marked crosswalk.

junction_turn.description: Move through a junction cell while staying on sidewalk edges only.

junction_u_turn.description: Reverse direction within a junction support graph while staying on sidewalk edges only.

slow_walk.description: Slow and conservative sidewalk walking profile.

cautious_cross.description: Cross only with a generous perceived gap.

normal_cross.description: Default crossing profile aligned with current runtime defaults.

assertive_cross.description: Accept smaller gaps and cross more aggressively.

ignore_gap_cross.description: Treat gaps as effectively always acceptable.
